kind: read-only context attribution, excluded from speed comparisons
sourceRevision: c085aa4ac8984661b19efad44b729e27979040c4 plus the recorded candidate patches
method: Install the standard React DevTools hook before page load. Read provider Fiber values after each commit without changing app props, state, DOM, or native selection behavior.
Compare each current provider value with the previous value for that Fiber or its alternate. Track identities through a WeakMap.
Match providers by value fields and mapped compiled owner. Observe six real canonical producers until final visible content and ordered durable verification pass.

The field named providers in raw files counts repeated observations before the active window, not unique providers or mounts. newProviders counts newly observed Fiber identities, not a public component mount counter.
The last two diagnostic sources also report which fields changed. All four source hashes and exact source text are retained here.

findings: File-link context remains stable during 300 ordered updates. No file-link code was changed.
The retained all-provider run records 670 recovery and 748 editor value changes during 300 ordered updates.
Recovery-only structural sharing removes recovery context updates. Editor context still changes 647 times with identical session, task, and activity fields.
The combined candidate records zero updates in both targeted contexts. All-provider value changes total 382, versus 1,818 in the retained diagnostic run.
These diagnostic runs are unpaired and can change scheduling. Counts do not establish a CPU, frame-rate, M2 Air, battery, or memory gain. Separate uninstrumented paired timing is required.

unitRed: Recovery consumer renders 21 times instead of 1 for 20 irrelevant updates.
Editor consumer renders 21 times instead of 1 for 20 identical values.
correctness.unitGreen: 113 checks pass across 10 test files. Recovery model, pending action, callback, and session-owner changes remain observable. Editor session, task, and activity changes remain observable.
correctness.temporarySources: All four temporary diagnostic tests removed after checksum verification. Exact source copies and browser artifacts retained.

previousExperiment: The earlier combined composer experiment was rejected. This candidate isolates its recovery-context sharing and adds editor-context stability identified by the fresh live trace. It does not restore the earlier submission selector or composer memoization.
